import sys, random; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, para, algo

def verify_cycle(cal, cyc):
    if not cyc: return False
    ids=[c-1 for c in cyc]
    if any(i<0 or i>=len(cal.edges) for i in ids): return False
    w=0
    for k in range(len(ids)):
        e=cal.edges[ids[k]]; n=cal.edges[ids[(k+1)%len(ids)]]
        if e[1]!=n[0]: return False
        w+=e[2]
    return w<0

            row=cal.upper[a]
